answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 24768 Country: India Title: "Where is mentioned in Quraan Hala meat is mendatory" please give the reference no.of english version quraan. Question: Dear Brother "where is mentioned in Quraan Hala meat is mendatory" please give the reference no.of english version quraan. Answer ID: 24768 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1368/983/L=1431) The holy Quran briefly mentions about slaughtering: وَلاَ تَأْكُلُواْ مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اسْمُ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ الآية [الأنعام : 121] Also it mentions the unlawfulness of animals killed by strangulation, or killed by a blow, or by a fall, or by goring, or that is eaten by a beast, which finally implies Islamic slaughterer. The complete details of slaughter are mentioned in hadith and fiqh books. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
